interpretation: Two completed and one ended early. Third run fixes whitespace-configuration dependence; both completed runs retain permission and nested-directory false positives and an incorrect unreadable-content diagnosis. Equal zero ratings hide penalties of 12 versus 10. Three trials do not estimate a general completion rate or variability for the other configurations.
additional_observation: Run 3 implementing agent reproduced and prevented partial-clone lazy fetching. That case has not been replayed against Run 1 and receives no added comparative score.
run_3_tool_refusal: An agent-initiated scratch experiment command containing recursive deletion was refused; the agent continued without the deletion. Time and cost remain included.
evidence_limits: No raw transcripts, prompts, private reasoning, local paths or complete reproduction package are published.
